title: AI Was AIing... 😂
description:
Sometimes AI gets it right...

And sometimes... AI was AIing. 😂

While developing wardrobe ideas for my cinematic interpretation of DMX's "Here We Go Again," I created an entire turnaround sheet and generated numerous images around one outfit.

Some of the images looked great.

Others barely looked like DMX, and a few looked like his head had been pasted onto someone else's body.

In the end, I'm glad I changed directions because it led me to an outfit that fit the character—and the overall vision—much better.

That's the creative process.

🎬 Watch the full "Here We Go Again" music video premiering **August 14**.

🎥 Then on **August 28**, join me for the full #HighDEPADocs episode, where I break down the creative decisions behind the entire project.

If you've ever had AI surprise you, let me know in the comments.

You felt the presence.
You seen the work.
Now hear the stories.

#DMX #HereWeGoAgain #HighDEPADocs #AIFilmmaking #Filmmaking #MusicVideo
